title: Appending a final edge to a merge fold
statement: Fix $n \in \bbn$ and a union-find state $\mathit{uf} \colon \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbn$ on $n$ nodes. For any list $l$ of weighted edges over $n$ vertices and any single weighted edge $e$ over $n$ vertices with endpoints $u$ and $v$, merging all edges of the list $l \mathbin{+\!\!+} [e]$ into $\mathit{uf}$ in order produces the same union-find state as first merging all edges of $l$ into $\mathit{uf}$ in order and then merging the components of $u$ and $v$ in the state so obtained.
hypotheses_covered: union-find state uf : Fin n → ℕ
list l of weighted edges over n vertices
single weighted edge e over n vertices with endpoints u, v
replaced:
Merging along $l \mathbin{+\!\!+} [e]$ equals first merging along $l$ and then merging the
endpoints of $e$:
$\mathit{uf}.\mathtt{mergeAll}\,(l \mathbin{+\!\!+} [e]) = (\mathit{uf}.\mathtt{mergeAll}\,l).\mathtt{merge}\,e.u\,e.v$.
